settings.markdown:
## Our rules
- **No Grand Exchange, no trading.** Everything you own, you got yourself.
- **Group content is fine.** Boss together, skill together; drops go to whoever the game gives them to.
- **Ask before you help.** Some members play group ironman or hardcore: check what they're happy with first.
- **Be kind.** Everyone is grinding something.

settings.title: Join the collective
settings.text: Say hello in our Discord and a recruiter will invite you in game.

items.q: Do I have to be an ironman to join?
items.a: Yes: regular, hardcore, group or ultimate are all welcome.

items.q: Can I lose my ironman status in the clan?
items.a: No. Clan chat, Citadel and group bosses never break ironman rules.
Yes. Capping is allowed and helps everyone.

items.q: How is the collection log made?
items.a: From the drops members log in game. Turn on drop sharing to fill it.
